items.title: 2026 Hero Xtreme 160R 4V Launch Price Rs 1.27 L – New TFT Display, Features
items.summary: The updated Xtreme 160R 4V gets Carbon and Pro variants, with 17.1 PS, three riding modes and a claimed 0–60 km/h time of 4.4 seconds. Hero MotoCorp has launched the updated 2026 Xtreme 160R at Rs 1.27 lakh, ex-showroom.

items.title: Royal Enfield Classic 650 Anniversary Edition Launch Price Rs 4.26 L – New Hypershift Paint
items.summary: Celebrating Royal Enfield’s 125th anniversary, the limited-edition Classic 650 features colour-shifting paint, commemorative detailing and a quilted brown leather seat. items.title: Mahindra XUV 3XO crosses 500,000 sales ahead of new CNG model launch
items.summary: The XUV 3XO is the latest model from the Mumbai-based Mahindra & Mahindra to achieve the 500,000 domestic market wholesales milestone. This total comprises sales of the XUV300 launched in April 2024 , the rebranded model XUV 3XO introduced in April 2024, and the XUV 3XO EV unveiled in January 2026.
